name: strata-chain-l40
description: Checkpoint chain on one L40S: one growing conversation 1k -> 100k -> 200k -> 262144, 512 tokens per turn.

estimate.basis: cold 262144 prefill ~64 s (2026-10-25-l40x1-256k); chain pays four prefills (delta if reuse engages) plus 4 x 512-token decode; staging + engine load ~10 min

caveats: This is not a cold rerun: turn 1 at ~1k is cold, later turns should reuse the previous prompt checkpoint. If reuse does not engage the numbers are full-context prefills and that is the finding.
The conversation cache is 8 GiB / 4 parked conversations on the baseline recipe; a 262k conversation can be evicted or exceed the cache, so later turns may fail to reuse.
Each stop is clamped to 262144 - 512 - 128 = 261504 prompt tokens; the top turn's prompt is therefore slightly below the model ceiling.
The historical cold 256K cells generated 128 tokens; this chain generates 512 per turn, so aggregate/decode compare only directionally.
The chain is C1 and sequential by design; it does not measure concurrency and does not park more than one conversation.
chain_last_repeats=1 adds one identical request at the top stop as a cheap cache-hit sanity check (expect reused ~= prompt-5).
